concerns.text: FR-001 (and several other FRs) reference a non‑existent identifier “US-1” (e.g., “(See US-1)”). The specification only defines “User Story 1” – the cross‑reference is broken, leaving the requirement unanchored.
Inconsistent terminology: the document alternates between “User Story 1” and the shorthand “US‑1”. This unstable naming can cause confusion and makes traceability harder.
